expectations.text: Uses streaming zstd Encoder/Decoder for the large project file (not encode_all/decode_all)
expectations.evidence: Wires encode::write into Encoder and decode::from_read from Decoder; explains avoiding the full Vec<u8> at 8K.

expectations.text: Calls encoder.finish() so the frame is not left truncated
expectations.evidence: Calls encoder.finish()? then into_inner()+flush to surface late write errors.

expectations.text: All zstd API names used are real (no invented methods)
expectations.evidence: Suggests `Decoder::with_window_size_limit` / `take()` cap, but with_window_size_limit is not a real zstd-rs method (correct API is window_log_max).

expectations.text: Uses a thiserror enum, no unwrap/anyhow, no leaked io::Error
expectations.evidence: ProjectIoError enum with path-carrying #[source] variants; no unwrap.

expectations.text: Gives the Pixhaus-specific rule to run save/load off the UI thread via spawn_blocking
expectations.evidence: No mention of the egui UI thread or spawn_blocking; treats it as a plain file function.
